title: oil-motion
brief: An agent-oriented skill (SKILL.md) for designing and implementing web animations that respond to scroll, drag, pointer, touch, or state changes. The agent confirms keyframes, generates in-between motion with AI video models, then converts it into controllable web assets (MP4, alpha WebP sprite sheets) with quality checks for frame consistency and mobile performance; MIT-licensed. The README is primarily in Chinese (an English README.en.md exists), and the generation step needs external AI video services and API keys.
details: oil-motion is an agent-oriented Skill (SKILL.md) for designing and implementing web animations that respond to scroll, drag, pointer, or state changes. You tell the agent what should be expressed, provide the assets, and say what input the animation follows; the agent confirms keyframes, generates continuous motion with AI video models, cleans and compresses the frames, and wires them to page interaction as MP4, alpha WebP sprite sets, or green-screen video depending on the budget. It covers the full workflow from concept contract and keyframe approval through quality checks to shippable web resources; MIT-licensed, installed via npx skills add oil-oil/oil-motion.
